spec.description: One FortiGate per independent installation. Discover VDOM/SLA/interface labels or use configured dropdown defaults; defaults never fabricate measurements. Usage follows VDOM and includes all traffic received by this installation's dedicated syslog listener. Usage groups MAC/IP/name, not authenticated accounts. Missing logs and period boundaries limit accounting. WAN selection affects interface/SLA panels, not device-usage totals.

spec.title: Recorded Internet Usage by Device — Today
spec.description: Recorded internet bytes: sentdelta/rcvddelta when present, including zero. Cumulative fallback is permitted only for forward-session end records (logid13); stat records (logid20) without valid deltas are excluded. Other log types, invalid byte fields, and records without master MAC are excluded. VDOM filters this report; the FortiGate and WAN selectors DO NOT filter it. One configured FortiGate is assumed for this dedicated syslog listener; sender identity is not verified by this assumption. No top-N truncation. This reports device MAC/IP/name combinations, not authenticated user accounts; IP/name changes can split a device. Windows are evaluated at log timestamps; interim intervals and end-only sessions may cross period boundaries. Missing logs cause incomplete totals; No data does not mean zero. Data gaps, duplicate delivery and missing field coverage are not repaired here.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(
  sum by (mastersrcmac, srcip, srcname) (
    sum_over_time(
      {job="fortigate-syslog"}
      |~ `logid="00000000(13|20)"`
      | logfmt type, subtype, logid, vd, dstintfrole, mastersrcmac, srcip, srcname, sentdelta, rcvddelta, sentbyte, rcvdbyte
      | __error__=""
      | type="traffic" | subtype="forward" | vd="${vdom}"
      | dstintfrole="wan" | mastersrcmac!=""
      | label_format tx=`{{if .sentdelta}}{{.sentdelta}}{{else if eq .logid "0000000013"}}{{.sentbyte}}{{end}}`, rx=`{{if .rcvddelta}}{{.rcvddelta}}{{else if eq .logid "0000000013"}}{{.rcvdbyte}}{{end}}`
      | tx=~`^[0-9]+$` | rx=~`^[0-9]+$`
      | label_format recorded_bytes=`{{add .tx .rx}}`
      | __error__=""
      | keep mastersrcmac, srcip, srcname, recorded_bytes
      | unwrap recorded_bytes | __error__=""
      [$__range]
    )
  ) / 1000000000
)

spec.description: Device-wide health for the selected FortiGate. VDOM selection does not filter this hardware/device-level metric. Current memory utilization.

spec.title: ${wan} Internet SLA
spec.description: Active Performance SLA state for ${sla} on ${wan}. ALIVE, DEAD, ERROR, DISABLED and UNKNOWN are distinct; missing metrics remain NO DATA. Codes: 0=dead, 1=alive, 2=error, 3=disabled, 4=unknown.

spec.expr:
sum without (state) (
  (0 * (fortigate_virtual_wan_status{job="fortigate",instance="${fortigate}",vdom="${vdom}",sla="${sla}",interface=~"${wan}",state="down"} == 1))
  or
  (1 * (fortigate_virtual_wan_status{job="fortigate",instance="${fortigate}",vdom="${vdom}",sla="${sla}",interface=~"${wan}",state="up"} == 1))
  or
  (2 * (fortigate_virtual_wan_status{job="fortigate",instance="${fortigate}",vdom="${vdom}",sla="${sla}",interface=~"${wan}",state="error"} == 1))
  or
  (3 * (fortigate_virtual_wan_status{job="fortigate",instance="${fortigate}",vdom="${vdom}",sla="${sla}",interface=~"${wan}",state="disable"} == 1))
  or
  (4 * (fortigate_virtual_wan_status{job="fortigate",instance="${fortigate}",vdom="${vdom}",sla="${sla}",interface=~"${wan}",state="unknown"} == 1))
)

spec.description: Percentage of received SLA samples that report UP over the last 24 hours at the selected end time. DOWN, ERROR, DISABLED and UNKNOWN samples count as not UP. spec.description: Percentage of received SLA samples that report UP over the last 7 days at the selected end time. Missing samples are excluded. A short or incomplete history can produce a high percentage; this is not a contractual SLA or proof that all 7 days were monitored.

spec.title: SLA Sample Coverage - 24 Hours
spec.description: Received per-interface SLA status samples divided by recorded Prometheus target scrape attempts over the last 24 hours. Failed scrapes remain in the denominator. Prometheus downtime or missing scrape history is not covered by this ratio. No recorded SLA samples stays No data, not zero.
